title: Renewable Asset Listing Standard (RALS) v0.1
description: JSON Schema for RALS, defining the structure of renewable energy asset listings. Field-level confidentiality tiers (public/nda_required/final_shortlist, SPEC 4.3) are annotated with the vendor extension keyword x-rals-tier; lib/teaser-filter.js is the enforced runtime allowlist derived from these tiers.

coordinates.description: WGS84 [longitude, latitude]. For portfolios, the centroid MAY be exposed as public.

units.description: Generating units (inverter blocks, turbine clusters, BESS racks). Technology-specific shape.

production_estimates.description: See SPEC 7.5. methodology is public so agents can filter by assessment quality without seeing the numbers.

offtake_structure.description: SPEC 8 defines this closed list; jurisdiction packages (RFC-0003) MAY extend it with regulator-specific mechanisms (e.g. eeg_market_premium, avoided_cost_tariff) not yet formalized as their own v0.1 category — see RFC-0002 roadmap item 4 (regulated revenue programs). Values outside x-rals-canonical-values are valid RALS but not yet part of the closed v0.1 vocabulary.

offtake_contracts.description: See SPEC 8.2. Required unless the asset is pure merchant.

contract_type.description: SPEC 8.2 defines this closed list; jurisdiction- or mechanism-specific values (e.g. avoided_cost_tariff, capacity_market) are permitted per RFC-0003 jurisdiction extension pending v0.2 (see RFC-0002 roadmap item 4).

structure_type.description: SPEC 8.2 defines this closed list; mechanism-specific values (e.g. capacity_payment_with_de_rating) are permitted per RFC-0003 jurisdiction extension pending v0.2.

capacity_mw.description: Contracted capacity; MAY exceed nameplate for financial overlays.

anzulegender_wert_eur_mwh.description: DE-specific EEG anzulegender Wert for gleitende_marktpraemie contracts.

capex.description: See SPEC 9.1. per_mw figure MAY be exposed as a rounded range in the Teaser tier.

breakdown.description: Itemized CAPEX, e.g. modules_eur, inverters_eur, mounting_eur, bos_eur, civil_works_eur, grid_connection_eur, development_permits_eur, epc_margin_eur, financing_costs_eur.

per_mw_per_year.description: Canonical taxonomy: om_service, land_lease, insurance, asset_management, direct_marketing, grid_charges, monitoring_scada, administrative, other. Implementers MAY add fields but MUST NOT remove/rename these.

total_per_mw_yr.description: Sum of the per_mw_per_year line items.

anzulegender_wert_eur_mwh.description: DE EEG assets use this instead of guaranteed_price_eur_mwh.

remaining_volume_mwh.description: null means the support is time-bound only, not volume-bound.

asking_price.description: See SPEC 9.5. An object, not a single number.

permit_type.description: Open vocabulary; MAY use jurisdiction-native values.

eu_taxonomy_alignment.description: See SPEC 10.2. Public so SFDR Article 8/9 buyer agents can screen for eligibility pre-NDA.

litigation_disputes.description: Open, threatened, or settled proceedings. An empty array asserts none.

insurance_coverage.description: Per coverage line; implementers MAY add additional lines.

monthly_production.description: See SPEC 11.1. Full monthly/turbine-level series MUST NOT be inlined past the 512 KB document limit.

service_contract.description: See SPEC 11.2. Single-provider object, or a structure note plus a contracts array when split between providers.

structure.description: Present instead of a flat shape when O&M is split between providers.

contracts.description: One entry per provider, same fields as the single-provider shape, when structure is split.

process_timeline.description: Dates are ISO 8601; range/quarter values MAY be free-text, e.g. '2027-Q1'.
